311	    /// Create a token on the battlefield with specific creature subtypes.
312	    /// If Parallel Lives is on the battlefield under the same controller,
313	    /// an additional copy of the token is created.
314	    pub fn create_token_with_subtypes(
315	        &mut self,
316	        name: &str,
317	        owner: PlayerId,
318	        power: i32,
319	        toughness: i32,
320	        colors: Vec<crate::types::Color>,
321	        card_types: Vec<crate::types::CardType>,
322	        keywords: Vec<crate::types::Keyword>,
323	        subtypes: Vec<String>,
324	    ) -> ObjectId {
325	        // Check for Parallel Lives (doubling effect).
326	        let parallel_lives_count = self.objects.values()
327	            .filter(|o| o.zone == Zone::Battlefield && o.controller == owner && o.name == "Parallel Lives")
328	            .count();
329	        // Each Parallel Lives doubles, so 1 PL = 2x, 2 PL = 4x, etc.
330	        // We create (2^N - 1) extra tokens.
331	        let extra_copies = if parallel_lives_count > 0 {
332	            (1u32 << parallel_lives_count) - 1
333	        } else {
334	            0
335	        };
336	
337	        // Create the primary token.
338	        let id = self.create_token_internal(name, owner, power, toughness,
339	            colors.clone(), card_types.clone(), keywords.clone(), subtypes.clone());
340	
341	        // Create extra copies for Parallel Lives.
342	        for _ in 0..extra_copies {
343	            self.create_token_internal(name, owner, power, toughness,
344	                colors.clone(), card_types.clone(), keywords.clone(), subtypes.clone());
345	        }
346	
347	        id
348	    }
